category.name: Security And Protection
category.preferred_workflow: Create any required source files locally, use Document.Protect or Document.Unprotect together with documented ProtectionType values, employ LoadOptions for password handling, and wrap unsupported asynchronous or cancellable operations in Task.Run while checking CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested. Always validate that the expected output file exists.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference Aspose.Words members that are not present in version 26.10.0.
canonical_patterns: Create deterministic input files, apply protection with Document.Protect, and save using documented SaveOptions.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate only the existence of the output document and the specific protection state required by the task.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because members such as LoadOptions.LoadingCallback, Document.LoadAsync, or Document.Dispose are not defined.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references APIs that do not exist in the shipped Aspose.Words package.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace invented members with the documented Document constructor, LoadOptions, and explicit token-aware wrappers using Task.Run.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words 26.10.0 reference and limit code to APIs listed in the key_apis set.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Build errors occur when passing a CancellationToken directly to Document.Load or Document.Save, and runtime checks cannot locate cancellation callbacks.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Aspose.Words does not expose overloads that accept a CancellationToken in this version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Wrap the load or save call inside Task.Run and invoke token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested before and after the operation.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Design cancellation logic around token checks surrounding synchronous Aspose.Words calls rather than expecting built-in overloads.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Code assumes that source documents, templates, or image files already exist, leading to FileNotFound exceptions or invalid test results.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Samples do not create the required files before processing.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Generate deterministic sample documents, templates, or images at the start of each example and clean them up afterward.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include a self-contained setup block that creates any files the task needs.

examples.task: Create a CancellationTokenSource and pass its token to Document.Load to enable interruption.

Use token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested inside a field update loop to abort long-running operations efficiently.
Implement a low-code UI button that calls CancellationTokenSource.Cancel to stop processing immediately.
Combine a CancellationToken with Document.SaveAsync to allow asynchronous saving cancellation by checking token status.
Monitor token.IsCancellationRequested during layout building and exit the layout routine promptly if needed.
Handle OperationCanceledException after a cancelled Document.Load to perform necessary cleanup properly.
Log cancellation events with timestamps to an audit file for compliance tracking.
Pass the same CancellationToken to both loading and saving methods for consistent interruption control.
Use token.IsCancellationRequested in a custom LINQ Reporting Engine query to abort large reports.
Wrap a batch of Document.Load calls in a foreach loop that checks token cancellation before each load.
Configure DocumentLoadingArgs to invoke a user-defined method when cancellation is requested during loading.
Integrate CancellationToken into a background worker that processes documents without blocking the UI.
Validate that long-running field updates respect the token by inserting periodic cancellation checks.
Create a reusable helper method accepting a CancellationToken to perform safe document processing.
Ensure resource leaks are prevented by disposing the Document object after catching OperationCanceledException.
Use token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested inside a custom image extraction routine to stop early if needed.
Combine token monitoring with progress reporting to inform users when cancellation occurs during processing.
Implement a timeout mechanism that triggers CancellationTokenSource.Cancel after a predefined duration automatically.
Pass the token to DocumentBuilder operations to allow interruption while constructing complex documents.
Test cancellation behavior by simulating user aborts during document layout generation in unit tests.
Document the required .NET version for CancellationToken support in the project's README file.
Use token.IsCancellationRequested within a while loop processing document nodes to enable graceful exit.
Provide a configuration setting that enables or disables cancellation support for specific processing stages.
Capture and log the stack trace when OperationCanceledException is thrown for debugging purposes.
Apply token checks before invoking external resource retrieval to avoid unnecessary network calls.
Create an extension method that adds cancellation support to existing synchronous Document.Save calls.
Ensure that the CancellationTokenSource is disposed after processing completes to free system resources.
Demonstrate chaining multiple CancellationTokens using CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource for complex workflows in applications.
Verify that document processing pipelines respect cancellation when integrated with third-party reporting tools.

narrative.overview: The Security and Protection category for Aspose.Words demonstrates how to apply document protection, load and save password-protected files, and manage cancellation of long-running operations. Verified examples show correct use of Document.Protect, Document.Unprotect, LoadOptions, and token-aware wrappers that respect the library's current API surface.
narrative.purpose: Provide concise, task-focused code snippets that enable developers to protect, unprotect, and safely load or save Word documents while handling cancellation without relying on undocumented or unavailable APIs.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the output file is created and that its protection status matches the requested ProtectionType.
maintenance_notes: Update the examples whenever a new Aspose.Words version adds native CancellationToken overloads to simplify the wrappers.
